title: Sort-only toLowerCase sites still sort by the engine lowercase (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), nit. src/commands/orphans.ts compareLower (~:466-469), src/core/workspace-projection.ts (~:204) and src/core/ladybug-source.ts (~:472) sort by toLowerCase while projection.ts sorts by referenceKey. Sorting only, not identity, but the orders can differ by Bun generation. Align them on one key.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The sort keys in orphans, workspace-projection and ladybug-source agree with projection.ts, with a test on a non-ASCII id
